hook.line: This guy is getting so much free traffic from Google, and I'll show you exactly what they did.
hook.visual: Tight handheld selfie, head resting on his hand, then a finger point at 2.3 s; a black box reading 'Steal this SEO strategy NOW' with a shocked emoji sits low in frame.

beats.what: Result-first line over a fixed 'Steal this SEO strategy NOW' title box.
No cut: the phone swings from his face to a laptop screen ('here are the receipts').
Finger traces a traffic bar chart climbing month by month.
Keyword ranking chart: top-3 keywords from zero in October.
Finger on the tooltip: 56 keywords in the top 3 by the summer.
First cut back to his face, raised eyebrows: 'these are our clients'.
The whole recipe on one screen: 8 pieces of content and 4 backlinks a month.
Content tool site name and a written prompt, which he says is in the comments.
Backlink tool site name filmed on the screen.
Back to face: clients pay $40,000 a year for this and he just gave it away.

why_it_works: Receipts before the method: the rising traffic chart comes before any how-to, so the viewer stays to see how it was done.
One continuous handheld move from face to screen (first cut at 20.2 s) feels like being shown over the shoulder, not presented to.
The method is boiled down to two numbers (8 posts, 4 links a month) that fit one screen and are easy to save (1,148 shares).
The price anchor at the end ($40k a year) reframes a free 40-second tip as something valuable.
weaknesses: No spoken-word captions at 4.39 words/s; muted viewers only get the fixed title.
Phone-filmed screens are moiré-striped and tilted; the tool names are readable but the prompt is not.
Quiet mix (measured -35.6 LUFS), well under typical TikTok loudness.
for_robert: Lead with the proof chart before the method. Fred could trace the climbing line with a fin, the way the finger does here, then tap the one-screen recipe so the key numbers land.
